---
title: "Rival Explanations"
---

Rival explanations record competing, qualifying, or alternative accounts for an
evidence pattern. They keep mechanism testing from becoming confirmation-only.

Canonical file:
[`rival-explanations.jsonl`](https://github.com/ashitaka-emishi/fspp-research-wrokbench/blob/master/projects/sacrificial-debt/data/rival-explanations.jsonl)

## Current Records

| Record | Proposition | Explanation type | Interaction | Support status | Review status | Packet |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sd-rival-000001` | `sd-prop-000001` | Statistical rebuttal to Jewish shirking allegations | `competing` | `supported` | `reviewed` | [sd-packet-000001](../packets/sd-packet-000001.qmd) |

## Current Meaning

The current rival explanation treats documented proportional military
participation as a competing or qualifying account. Later claims about
non-dischargeability must show, with separate actor-source evidence, that
accusations persisted despite available contribution evidence.

## Review Boundary

Rival explanations do not automatically falsify a hypothesis, but they raise
the evidentiary burden for promoting a claim.
